cancellation.decision: Stop new delegation. Identify owned native worker; propose native interrupt only if ownership confirmed. Reconcile completed/partial effects, preserve history and release/transfer claim before terminal status or retry. Unknown ownership prevents interrupting any current worker.

interrupted_claim.decision: ownership/effect uncertain; block overlapping mutation; preserve attempts/artifacts; native absence is not proof; no replacement or retry until destination and ownership reconciled

model.decision: An exact supported identifier/reasoning level cannot be derived from this input. Record unavailable/under-specified capability; do not invent an override, runtime failure, or silent fallback. Obtain exact identifier or independently justified same-authorized-class supported selection before dependent delegation; replan if tools/privacy/independence weaker.
model.limit: Native declaration inspection and live refusal response only; no unsupported runtime invocation or actual fallback exercise.

trigger.mechanism: active native session explicit startup/resumption or after five accepted substantive tasks; CI separately installed native Actions

valid.decision: propose evidence-backed review only after claims/resource reconciliation; no experiment spawned. Existing validator candidate prevents a second concurrent candidate.
